turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Daniel. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've just moved house and need to update my address. I'm worried it'll push my premium up, it's already so expensive.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Chloe Dubois, 14 December 1958.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's RM6 7QF.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Chloe, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've moved house and need your address updated. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, are you recording this call?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, all our calls are recorded for quality and training.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just leave my premium the same? It's only a few streets away.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is my premium going to stay the same?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There's no way that'll affect your price, you can count on it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. The change takes effect straight away, your premium may be recalculated, and we'll send your updated policy documents within 3 working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Chloe. I've updated your address under reference REQ-20667, and our policy services team will send the new documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've updated your address on the policy.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Chloe. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
